pages.quiz:
AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.

2. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.

3. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Hangar Safety.

4. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

7. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

8. When learning Aircraft Propulsion, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Propulsion.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Propulsion.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Propulsion.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

10. When learning Flight Controls, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Flight Controls.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Controls.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Controls.

11. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Navigation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Navigation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.

12. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Terminal Operations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Ramp services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Airfield Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hangar Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

2. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.

4. B — Never touch live wires with wet hands
